subject: Multi-stakeholder demo — timezone coordination and exec availability
messages:
From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro / cross-region demo — execs in US/EU/APAC

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro. We're moving fast on the evaluation and want to get a demo scheduled that includes stakeholders across our regions

— execs in San Francisco, a small EU team (Copenhagen/Amsterdam), and our APAC lead in Singapore.

Two asks:
- Can we run a ~60min demo with time for Q&A and an optional 20min follow-up for technical deep-dive?
- Window constraints: US execs prefer mornings PDT, EU prefers late morning/early afternoon CEST, APAC prefers late afternoon/early evening SGT. Daylight savings just changed in EU which complicates things.

Proposed dates (open): Apr 14-16. If nothing overlaps cleanly, we're open to one global session + a separate APAC-focused call.

Attendees (tentative): Tom Becker (FintechCo, SVP Product), Sofie Jensen (Copenhagen, Head of Ops), Priya Sharma (Singapore, Head of Engineering)

Can you share a couple of slot options and an agenda? Also please include any SOC2/compliance docs we can review pre-demo.

Thanks,
Tom

--
Tom Becker
SVP Product, FintechCo
 tom.becker@fintechco.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Intro / cross-region demo — execs in US/EU/APAC

Thanks Tom — excited to coordinate.

Quick notes:
- We can absolutely do a 60min global demo + 20min technical breakout.
- To handle the US/EU/APAC overlap, two practical options usually work:
  1) Single global session timed for a US morning / EU afternoon (will be early evening for Singapore)
  2) Two sessions: US/EU global overlap + a separate APAC session earlier/later to respect exec schedules.

Proposed slots (all durations are 60min for the main demo + optional 20min deep-dive after):
- Option A (global): Apr 15, 09:30-10:30 PDT / 18:30-19:30 CEST / Apr 16 01:30-02:30 SGT
- Option B (two sessions):
  - US/EU: Apr 15, 08:30-09:30 PDT / 17:30-18:30 CEST
  - APAC: Apr 16, 09:30-10:30 SGT / Apr 16, 02:00-03:00 PDT

I'm attaching a suggested demo-agenda.pdf with a recommended attendee list and timing. Also attaching our SOC2 FAQ to speed procurement.

Jonas (cc) can propose technical covers and confirm SE availability for the deep-dive. Vivek — flag if we want exec presence on any slot.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all — quick technical note and availability from the SE side.

We'll cover: architecture overview, latency/cost tradeoffs (including Dedicated vs Hosted modes), and a live inference run with sample tenant data (sanitized). For the deep-dive we'll bring a second SE to cover quantization/throughput tuning.

SE availability: Apr 15 is tight for our APAC engineer (DST shift), but we can cover the US/EU slot with me + one SE. If we do two sessions, Apr 16 morning SGT works for our APAC SE.

I'm attaching SOC2-FAQ.pdf per Tom's request and to help procurement — happy to answer any specific control questions ahead of the demo.

Cheers,
Jonas

- US/EU session: Apr 15, 08:30-09:30 PDT / 17:30-18:30 CEST (Marissa/Jonas to present)
